startUrls.title: Seed URLs (BFS roots)
startUrls.description: LinkedIn profile/company/pulse URLs to start crawling from. Example: https://www.linkedin.com/in/williamhgates

maxRequests.title: Max pages (no cap = 50000)
maxRequests.description: Max pages to crawl in this run. No hard cap — set 50000 for uncapped BFS. Apify credits limit is the only cap.

maxDepth.title: Max BFS depth
maxDepth.description: 0 = seeds only, 1 = seeds + their LinkedIn links, 2+ = transitive. Cap 64 links/page. Depth 2 with 5 seeds ≈ 8k pages.

maxLinksPerPage.title: Max LinkedIn links to enqueue per page
maxLinksPerPage.description: Seaxflare caps 64. Lower = narrower BFS. 64 is recommended.

spoofUserAgent.title: SPOOF_USER_AGENT
spoofUserAgent.description: UA spoof lever from searxflare ffec2c2. claude-user is optimal for LinkedIn (500-750k full SSR, ld+json). chrome/google also work. curl always 999 wall. Custom passes verbatim.

useApifyProxy.title: Proxy through Apify (keeps local IP clean)
useApifyProxy.description: ON = egress via Apify proxy (auto datacenter). Proved 200 for Claude-User from cloud (100.48.66.211). OFF = direct egress (local IP). With your $85 dev credits, keep ON.

proxyGroups.title: Apify proxy groups
proxyGroups.description: Groups to use when proxy ON. auto = cheapest datacenter (proven 200 for LinkedIn). Use RESIDENTIAL only if datacenter gets wall.

maxConcurrency.title: Concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Parallel pages. 5-10 is LinkedIn-safe. Higher hits 429 jitter threshold (jeffweiner08 429 after burst).

attemptsPerUrl.title: Transient attempts per URL
attemptsPerUrl.description: Maximum attempts for transient network/429/5xx responses. HTTP 999 and terminal 4xx responses stop immediately regardless of this value.
